sources.title: Ling-3.0-tiny-int4 · Models
sources.snippet: We are introducing Ling-3.0-tiny, a lightweight hybrid reasoning MoE model with 7.9B total parameters and only 1.3B activated parameters per token. It is designed to deliver strong reasoning and agentic capabilities at low inference cost, making advanced model capabilities more accessible for local and resource-constrained deployment.

sources.title: Ling 3.0 Tiny Review: Ant Group's 7.9B MoE Model (August 2026)
sources.snippet: Ling 3.0 Tiny is a 7.9-billion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model from InclusionAI, Ant Group's AI research division, released on 6 August 2026. It activates only around 1.3 billion parameters per token, ships with a native 256K-token context window, switchable Thinking and Instant reasoning modes, native function calling, and prompt caching.
